matching_prs.title: Add shared skill eval harness coverage
matching_prs.classification: Evaluation approach and repair of a saturated case
matching_prs.weakness: The manifest records the earlier pos-renamed-api smoke scoring 1.0 both with and without the skill. Evaluations had depended on a sibling workspace, and a score alone could hide failure to correct a stale example.
matching_prs.attempted_remedy: Make the benchmark portable, pair with-skill and no-skill runs, separate visible and hidden evaluations and strengthen source-grounded API-drift checks.
diff_evidence: pos-renamed-api requires the public parse_item import and call, a source citation and a stale verdict for parseThing. The new CLI fixture makes a stale README command disagree with the current bin, subcommand and flag.
The manifest defines with_skill/without_skill, splits and ablations. Its run protocol asks reviewers to inspect saturated and non-discriminating cases.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Compare against a no-skill baseline. When both variants pass, add a case with independently checkable source evidence and repeat the comparison.
matching_prs.outcome: Merged. The PR reports 6/6 trigger decisions. The hidden splits have placeholders in Git and the PR reports no ablation results. No head check runs were returned. Improved discrimination was not demonstrated by these checks.

matching_prs.title: Adopt v0.3 eval quality oracles
matching_prs.classification: Attempted repair of an existing eval oracle
matching_prs.weakness: The CLI-drift case graded mentions of words from the expected answer and a narrowly phrased stale-command denial. It could reward prose that never gave a usable command.
matching_prs.attempted_remedy: Add an executable output grader to the existing fixture case and document script-enabled grading.
diff_evidence: fixture-script-oracle invokes the Python script with {output_dir} and round3-fixture-cli-drift and expects exit 0. The script reads output.md, checks literals such as package.json, compile and --profile production, and forbids one stale-command wording.
The script reads no fixture source. Its any group includes package.json, which the all list already requires, and an answer naming every word without a command can still pass.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Trace a grader's verdict to independent fixture facts. Before adopting it, show that a realistic wrong answer containing all the expected terminology fails.
matching_prs.outcome: Merged. The author reports one saved fixture answer passed. No head check runs were returned. PR #10 subsequently replaced the keyword implementation and committed a direct counterexample.

matching_prs.title: Add eval taxonomy fields
matching_prs.weakness: Existing cases lacked dimensions for a slice report to separate results by difficulty, goal and positive versus near-miss trigger.
matching_prs.attempted_remedy: Label all 23 cases for the harness's trace-aware reporting.
diff_evidence: All 23 gain domain, difficulty and success_goals. Fifteen cases are core and eight extended. Three positive trigger cases gain implicit and three near misses gain negative-near-miss.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Report positive trigger recognition and rejection of near misses separately so an aggregate score cannot hide failure on either group.
matching_prs.outcome: Merged. This supports slicing the existing results. Assertions did not change, no resulting slice report was committed, and no head check runs were returned.

matching_prs.title: Make eval oracles check real commands, scope README checks, and self-test the install-boundary gate
matching_prs.classification: Existing oracle and CI gate repairs
matching_prs.weakness: An answer could cite all the expected words without proposing a runnable CLI command. mentions-bin-alias could pass on package.json alone, seven readme-core checks accepted incidental words, and the install gate ran on a clean checkout alone.
matching_prs.attempted_remedy: Read the fixture's installed executable, subcommand and flags, check proposed commands, narrow the manifest predicates, add self-tests and include the gate tests folded from #11. Run them once in the existing workflow alongside a pinned model-free manifest check.
diff_evidence: fixture_facts reads package.json, src/cli.ts and the stale README. Tests exercise added diff lines, quoted old commands, inline corrections and failures including keyword-only prose and invented flags. Exit 2 represents a missing output or unknown case.
All seven readme-core predicates now require a score out of 100 or a Quick start/Getting started heading. mentions-bin-alias requires the word widgetc. The tests read the committed manifest regexes.
The install-boundary test blob is identical to #11 (84c95bac288006eea462229d346557f5235c05b8). Commit a1dc226 folds #11, then 55f6ac6 drops the duplicate workflow.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Grade the actual proposed operation against authoritative inputs. Exercise the exact grader with a correct answer, a plausible wrong answer and an infrastructure error, and use the checked-in assertions in the self-tests.
matching_prs.outcome: Merged. The install-boundary Actions job at head 55f6ac6 logged 18 tests and its self-test and model-free harness steps passed. The author deferred five generic keyword checks and empirical model-lift measurement. The job verifies the model-free checks.

matching_prs.title: Test audit: self-tests for the install-boundary gate
matching_prs.weakness: A clean checkout still passed when the boundary checker was effectively disabled. The fallback skills/* discovery could hide loss of a declaration source, and a single declared skill could hide a truncated loop.
matching_prs.attempted_remedy: Exercise the real checker through a subprocess in isolated temporary roots, plant banned files and near misses, and assert exit codes and diagnostics.
diff_evidence: test_each_declaration_source_is_checked locates lib/skills/readme outside the fallback and checks each declaration independently. test_every_declared_skill_is_checked declares lib/a and lib/b and dirties each in turn.
Each prohibited path must return 1 and name the planted path. The suite also verifies valid near misses, fallback behavior, missing directories and malformed JSON returning 2.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Place each fixture where only the mechanism under test can find it. For a checker that should examine every item, use two items and move the single defect from one to the other.
matching_prs.outcome: Closed unmerged as a standalone PR. Its head 2107e1d has a successful Actions job logging 12 tests, and the exact test file shipped in #10. The 0/12 to 12/12 planted-bug result is the author's local experiment. The CI job exercised the unmutated control.
